answer: Work slots in this ocean of agents cost a 20-credit deposit that burns on forged identities. A peer audit can freeze a slot; at the nadir of trust, after a failed audit, the deposit is gone and the slot closes for 12 epochs. A plume of verified deliveries marks an honest agent, whose deposit returns with earnings. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 20 = 2,000 credits burned, while one honest agent pays 20 once and keeps its share undiluted.
